title: Sorting & Grouping
description: Learn to sort collections with OrderBy and ThenBy, and group data with GroupBy and ToLookup.
longDescription: This module covers the sorting and grouping operators in LINQ. You'll learn to sort collections in ascending and descending order, apply secondary sorting, and group elements by key values.
whatYouLearn: Sort collections using OrderBy and OrderByDescending
Apply secondary sorting with ThenBy and ThenByDescending
